svg.title: Actuary — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as actuary, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A probability curve is clearly separated from its chart axes above a sparse three-column observation table. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
